full_judgment: 2. The complainant petitioner lodged an FIR on 6-12-81 at PS Hathazari alleging that on 5-12-81 at about 5-00 AM the 8 accused persons namely, Abul Kashern Chowdhury, Azizul Haque, Afzal Ahmed, Mofzal Ahmed, Jamal Hossain, Nurul Islam, Md. Alam and Md. Idris along with 10/15 others took away from complainant's land paddy worth Taka 3,000 from his possession and that the paddy was grown by him. The Police investigated into the case and submitted final report. The Sub-Divisional Magistrate accepted the final report and discharged the accused persons on 2-2-82. Thereafter the complainant petitioner filed a complaint before the Sub Divisional Magistrate, Sadar (North), Chittagong on 8-2-82. The case being exclusively triable by the Village Court, the Sub-Divisional Magistrate sent the case to the Village Court for disposal as the value of the alleged stolen property was less than Taka 5,000. The Chairman, Hathazari Union Parishad constituted Village Court on 4-12-82 under section 5 of the Village Court Ordinance, 1976 with himself and four nominees (two from each of the parties) as members of Village Court. Mr. Md. Ismail and Mr. Md Manu Meah were nominees of the complainant while the defence nominated Mr. Abul Khair and Haji Md. Illias Sowdagar as their nominees. On 11-12-82 complainant prayed for time although the accused persons and their nominees were present. In the presence of the complainant 18-12-82 was fixed for examination of the complainant and his witnesses. On 18-12-82 the complainant and his witnesses did not appear and did not make any prayer for adjournment through anyone. Yet the Village Court in the interest of justice fixed 25-12-82 for examination of the complainant and his witnesses; but even on that date the complainant and his witnesses did not appear. Thereafter the Chairman fixed 1-1-83 for examination of the complainant's witnesses. On 1-1-83 the complainant and the accused persons appeared. The case was heard. The Village Court observed in its order dated 1-1-83 that the complainant could not show any document in support of his claim of the land while the accused persons produced their documents in support of their title and possession in the land. In also appears that on 1-1-83 complainant Syedul Hoque Sowdagar as PW 1 and Tamju Miah as PW 2 were examined. In the order dated 1-1-83 it is also stated that 15-1-83 is fixed for delivery of judgment. On 15-1-81 the complainant was absent and his two nominated members were also absent. On that date, i.e. on 15-1-83 the Chairman alone with two nominated members namely, Mr. Abul Khair and Md. Illias delivered the judgment acquitting the accused persons. One Farook Ahmad (a member of the local Union Parishad) also sat with them and after the signatures of the Chairman and the two members of the said Village Court has also put his signature below the judgment pronounced on 15-1-83.
